0|c10841ca722a0bc960dc541c51582773f9a24f98|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"cfg80211: fix deadlock with rfkill/sched_scan by adding new mutex
There was a deadlock when rfkill-blocking a wireless interface
because we were locking the rdev mutex on NETDEV_GOING_DOWN to stop
sched_scans that were eventually running.  The rfkill block code was
already holding a mutex under rdev:
kernel: [ INFO: possible circular locking dependency detected ]
kernel: kworker/0:1/4525 is trying to acquire lock:
kernel: (&rdev->mtx){+.+.+.}
kernel:
kernel: but task is already holding lock:
kernel: (&rdev->devlist_mtx){+.+.+.}
kernel:
kernel: which lock already depends on the new lock.
To fix this
column2: add a new mutex specifically for sched_scan

column1: the sched_scan_req element in the rdev struct
global rdev mutex.
